negative_reviews.author: Jessica M
negative_reviews.text: Despite the 15 second rule to eat hand rolls, when I asked to sit for a 30 minute seating before a show I was looked up and down and told ‘I don’t think we will do that, sorry’ despite the restaurant being near empty. This was for a table for two, my partner and I were both well dressed well and polite. I never leave reviews like this but haven’t encountered such judgemental service either. If it was an issue, it should have been handled better. A shame as the restaurant looked lovely but go to Kumori instead

negative_reviews.author: Wanjira Murage
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience, especially considering we had a reservation.

We waited around 40 minutes just to receive a bottle, and when it finally arrived, one of the glasses was cracked. Our table was soaking wet when we were seated and no one bothered to clean or attend to it properly.

The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority.

We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained.

Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, wet table, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend.

negative_reviews.author: Josh Bilbe
negative_reviews.text: Not that great. The quality of the fish wasn't amazing and that and the price wasn't up-to-par with other sushi restaurants in the area.
